utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still lining up the Saturday repair drive on the front porch, and a couple of helpers would make it much easier. Could you help keep things simple?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and help line up a couple of helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, Tess — I’m happy to help at the front porch this Saturday. What time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren, that helps a lot. I’ll send you the start time and a quick rundown soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Uli — can you help at the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help at the front porch on Saturday. Just let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik. I’m still lining up a couple of helpers for Saturday on the front porch, so if you can lend a hand I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I can help at the front porch this Saturday for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right. Thanks for spreading the word, Tess - a few extra hands on Saturday would make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll keep spreading the word and try to round up a few more helpers for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help set it up on Saturday at the front porch. Just let me know what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — it starts at 10 a.m. on Saturday at the front porch. I really appreciate the help!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Vik — I’ll count on you at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll be there at the front porch Saturday to help with the repair drive.
